fontLicensePolicy: Existing renamed Source Sans 3 Regular WOFF2 reused unchanged at weight400 in both variants. Original source and OFL notice retained.
mode: Previously generated photographic artwork and paper presentation reused unchanged. Native SVG text and geometry composed separately. No new image generation.

layout_record.method: Declared fill-only changes within three controlled photographic examples. The first two preserve color count and approximately match saturation/relative luminance while changing hue span; the third retains hue/saturation and intentionally changes only text lightness.

comparisonPolicy: First and third programme surface hues become teal/blue around an unchanged cyan; House/Night coffee surfaces widen a near-single hue into a local warm arc around unchanged Orchard; four supper detail fills darken at nominal fixed hue140/saturation30. Only two/two/four fills change. Three surface colors remain three in the first two, with approximately matched luminance/saturation. All words, font settings, positioning, geometry, photographic sources/crops and presentation remain fixed.
colorModel: Digital HSL. Local hue arcs are specimen choices, not universal definitions or equal perceptual steps.

verification.textBounds: within the declared paper or phone surface
verification.pixelCheck: Only intended declared analogous-color intervention regions differ.
verification.scope: Exact DOM normalization permits only declared fill attributes. All other artifact nodes and embedded image/font bytes remain identical. Wide/stacked browser checks cover text bounds, loaded fonts, horizontal overflow, image/inline SVG equality and pixels outside declared color regions.

limitations: Editorial judgments about color character, not measured unity, emotional response, recognition speed or preference. Approximate relative-luminance matching after 8-bit quantization does not establish equal perceived lightness. Local HSL arcs are examples, not universal harmony boundaries. Specified-color contrast ratios are not physical print proof or complete accessibility conformance.
